meta.source: Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal v1 (https://storage.googleapis.com/open-buildings-temporal-data), Sentinel-2 based annual building presence 2016-2023, 4 m effective resolution, 0.5 m pixels, EPSG:32631
meta.access: public GCS bucket open-buildings-temporal-data; manifests 11_EPSG_32631_<year>_06_30.json (token 11 covers Lagos; token 13 lies north of the AOI); ranged COG reads via /vsicurl/ - no tile downloaded

thresholds.note: building_presence is an uncalibrated model confidence; thresholded, never read as a probability

method.bands: 0-10 / 10-20 / 20-50 m from the channel centreline (or rings around the point for point-geometry sites), clipped to the site's 300 m radius
method.resampling: 8x8 block-mean of the 0.5 m building_presence pixels -> 4 m cells on a world 4 m-aligned grid, then thresholded
method.built_fraction: share of band cells with valid data whose block-mean presence >= threshold
method.newly_built: a cell is newly built in year t if built in t and t+1 and not built in t-1 and t-2 (threshold 0.5); defined for 2018-2022 only; area = cells x 16 m^2
method.channels: OSM waterway=drain|canal|stream|ditch|river within the site's 300 m radius (Task 18 osm.geojson when current, else a fresh Overpass query), plus the site geometry where the recorded structure is a channel and the line is a channel alignment rather than a road (per-site decisions recorded under channel.geometry_note)
method.baseline: 200 random 300 m segments of OSM waterways in the AOI [2.6, 6.28, 4.45, 6.85], at least 1000 m from any named site (seed 21); same bands and series
method.nodata: presence nodata -99 excluded before the block-mean

caveats: 4 m effective resolution: the 0-10 m band is 2-3 cells wide - read trends, not exact counts
Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal annual composites are dated <year>_06_30 and are Sentinel-2 derived; small or temporary structures may be missed

validation.method: 2023 presence >= 0.5 mask vs OSM building footprints (Task 18 osm.geojson, current geometry) at 4 m: a cell is OSM-built when its centre falls inside a footprint. Precision = fraction of Open-Buildings-built cells that contain an OSM footprint; recall = fraction of OSM footprint cells the mask detects. OSM completeness varies across Lagos, so recall is an agreement score, not a ground-truth accuracy; overlays saved against the latest Wayback chip.
